item.title: 20 vehicle crash on local interstate
item.description: The express lanes at the I-271 and I-480 split in Warrensville Heights has re-opened after 20 vehicles were involved in a crash Monday night.

item.title: Warming temps ahead of big drop, heavy rain
item.description: Plenty of sunshine with a few clouds later in the day

item.title: Bill aims to replace SNAP cards to protect Ohioans from fraud
item.description: Efforts are underway in both chambers of the Ohio Legislature to make it harder for scammers to steal money from the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program or SNAP.

item.title: See it! Another meteor spotted over Ohio
item.description: A flash of light. A moment of thinking about something bigger than our little lives. When a meteor came booming over Northeast Ohio last week on St. Patrick's Day, residents were in awe.

item.title: Now a true pop star, Miley Cyrus returns to her 'Hannah Montana' roots to fete anniversary special
item.description: Sporting that “Hannah Montana” blond hair and bangs, Miley Cyrus went back to her roots — celebrating 20 years of the TV show that launched the career of a real-life pop star.

item.title: Man known for being a quadruple-amputee cornhole star charged with murder
item.description: A professional cornhole player is behind bars after he allegedly shot and killed someone during an argument in a Maryland town over the weekend, according to officials.

item.title: Sharks in the Bahamas test positive for cocaine, caffeine and other drugs: What's to blame?
item.description: Sharks off the coast of the Bahamas are ingesting drugs including cocaine and caffeine, and it appears pollution at the hands of humans is to blame.

item.title: Dirty dozen produce 2026: list
item.description: A lot of popular fruit and vegetables continue to carry pesticide residues, including PFAS “forever chemicals.”

item.title: Barbies sold at discount store test positive for cocaine and fentanyl
item.description: Shipment of Barbie dolls at Cargo Largo in Independence, Missouri, found to contain cocaine with trace amounts of fentanyl.

item.title: Ohio bill would require fetal life and death certificates
item.description: A recently introduced Ohio bill would require the filing of a “certificate of life” after the detection of a fetal heartbeat and the registration of all fetal deaths.
